steps.en: Register the repo as a Claude Code plugin marketplace
steps.zh: 把仓库注册成 Claude Code 插件市场

steps.en: Install only the category bundles you need
steps.zh: 只装你需要的那几个类别包
steps.code: claude plugin install voltagent-lang · claude plugin install voltagent-infra

steps.en: Each role loads as a subagent with trigger description and tool limits
steps.zh: 每个角色以 subagent 载入，自带触发描述与工具权限

steps.en: Each agent arrives pre-routed to opus, sonnet or haiku; override the model field to change it
steps.zh: 按角色预路由 opus/sonnet/haiku，改 model 可覆写

steps.en: Let Claude Code auto-delegate, or invoke one by name
steps.zh: 让 Claude Code 自动委派，或点名调用
steps.code: Have the code-reviewer subagent analyze my latest commits

value.en: Domain experts in isolated context windows without hand-writing frontmatter or role prompts
value.zh: 不用手写 frontmatter 和角色提示，就得到各自隔离上下文的领域专家

sources: README.md main @ 2026-09-28: Installation 'As Claude Code Plugin (Recommended)' (`claude plugin marketplace add VoltAgent/awesome-claude-code-subagents`; `claude plugin install voltagent-lang` / `claude plugin install voltagent-infra`)
README.md 'Subagent Structure' + 'Smart Model Routing': frontmatter template `model: sonnet`, opus/sonnet/haiku routing table, `model: inherit` override
README.md 'Understanding Subagents' / 'Deploy and Utilize': `Have the code-reviewer subagent analyze my latest commits`; independent context windows; /agents manager
